evidence: Template fidelity: task/tests/test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, Dockerfile and .dockerignore are byte-identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template (diff -q SAME for all six); task.toml differs from the template only in [task] name/description/keywords and [metadata] text, so [verifier] timeout_sec=13200 and the frozen [verifier.env] block are intact. Contract trace against staged-task-contract.md 'tests/test.sh': (1) write_zero_reward at test.sh:60 writes reward.txt '0.0', reward.json with reward, all five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op (line 8) and a ctrf.json; `trap cleanup EXIT` at :61 calls ensure_reward (:20-23, :39) on every exit; no `exec` anywhere. (2) Missing /app/server.js -> exit 0 (:68-70); every symlink outside /app/node_modules, or inside it whose readlink -f target escapes /app/node_modules, -> exit 0 (:72-83). This refusal is publicly disclosed in environment/instructions/integration.md ('Symbolic links are supported only inside /app/node_modules, and their resolved targets must also stay inside /app/node_modules'). (3) /app copied aside to /tmp/submission (:90-95); app launched via `setsid env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT DB_PATH setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups node $APP_ENTRY` (:104-111); LOG_DIR is chmod 700 root (:11) and /tests is go-rwx (:12, Dockerfile:44), so the uid-65534 app cannot read rubrics or forge reward files. (4) Liveness: probe_ready tries 127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then / (HTTPError counts as reachable), 120 x 0.25 s; not ready -> exit 0 with the zero record (:115-125). Brief agrees: instruction.md:13 (node /app/server.js, port 3000, GET /api/health never touches DB, DB_PATH), integration.md (listens on 0.0.0.0, matching the 127.0.0.1 probe), hireops_rules.md section 8 (env -i variable list, unprivileged, possible writable copy). (5) Restart helper generated by heredoc + sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (:127-193); it rewrites app.pid so cleanup kills the restarted process group. (6) {app_context} substituted into /tests/*/*/prompt.md (:195-201). (7) gates suite (timeout 1500) then score.py: rewardkit failure/timeout -> exit 0 keeping the zero; score.py exit 0 continues, 1 exits keeping the detailed zero-reward record, other -> write_zero_reward (:212-222). (8) scored suite (timeout 11100) then score.py || write_zero_reward (:224-227); rewardkit failure -> exit 0 and the post-gates record already says reward 0.0 because `rm -rf $LOG_DIR/scored` (:212) guarantees scored_ran=false at the gates scoring. Budgets nest: gates judges 600+600 sequential (--max-concurrent-agent 1) < 1500; scored judges 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100; 1500+11100 = 12600 (+<=30 s liveness) < 13200. Measured (local Python 3.12, frozen score.py, fabricated RewardKit outputs; evidence/21/score_sim.txt): gate render=0 -> exit 1, reward 0.0000; gates pass with no scored output -> exit 0, reward 0.0000; gates pass + functional 0.5/polish 1.0/visual 0.6 -> exit 0, reward 0.6200 (=0.6*0.5+0.2*1+0.2*0.6); functional at floor 0.05 -> exit 0, reward 0.0000; non-numeric functional -> exit 2 (test.sh:227 then writes zero); missing gates reward.json -> exit 2 (test.sh:221 writes zero). Weak-app probe: an app that answers 500 everywhere passes the liveness probe by design, but liveness here is only reachability; the render/constraints gates and score.py gates_passed then zero it, so no reward leak. Conforming-alternative probe: a correct app that binds only to ::1/'localhost' would never be ready and score 0, but integration.md mandates 0.0.0.0; an app whose startup exceeds ~30 s would score 0, but the brief requires /api/health to answer before database work; an app relying on symlinks or inherited env vars is told not to. No undisclosed launch assumption found. Latent (P3, template-controlled, not task-editable): mkdir/chmod of LOG_DIR (:10-11) precede write_zero_reward under set -e, so a log mount refusing chmod would end with no reward file; identical to the canonical template and not an authoring defect. RISK REASON: test.sh itself has not been executed for this candidate. raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; workspace.cjs (hash verified) drives the golden directly as uid 65534 and never invokes test.sh/setpriv path (grep found no test.sh reference). The pass is a source trace plus a score.py-only simulation; the full verifier launch/grading runtime record required by REVIEW_POLICY remains missing.
